# FigureSpec

`jaff.plotting.FigureSpec`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

A whole figure: grid shape, row-major axes, theme and legend policy.

`legend_title` (optional) heads the shared legend, or the stack of
per-panel legend groups with `legend="axes"`.

`style` / `palette` are validated in `from_dict` but stored
unresolved (a deep copy of the name, dict or list); the renderer resolves
them with `resolve_style` /
`resolve_palette`.

## Constructor

`#!python FigureSpec(axes, grid=(1, 1), style=None, palette=None, figsize=None, sharex=False, sharey=False, legend='auto', title=None, legend_title=None)`
